regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: The paper reports aerobic oxidation of homopropargylic alcohols and silica-gel isomerization to allenic ketones at an aggregate level. No experiment-specific row or complete condition set appears in this region.

Dess–Martin/Swern, Hashmi silica workup, RuCl3/TBHP, Cr-catalyzed methods, and the authors' earlier Fe(NO3)3·9H2O/TEMPO/NaCl alcohol oxidation are cited prior work. They are classified as literature context and not as new experiments of this paper. The paragraph introduces generic Scheme 1 on page 2.

unresolved: The cited prior-work summaries do not provide uniquely mapped substrate/product identities, exact yields, or complete conditions and were not expanded into external-paper experiment records.

regions.finding: Generic comparison of traditional oxidation (DMP/DMSO/CrO3/TBHP) with the current aerobic oxidation/isomerization concept; classified as a general scheme, not a unique experiment.

regions.region: page 2 left-column Scheme 2 and Table 1 rows 1–6 with footnotes
regions.finding: Six optimization conditions were accounted for. Scheme 2 and Table 1 entry 1 are the same 1a-to-2a result (91% NMR, 4 h) and are merged with the page-3 typical procedure. Rows 2–6 remain independent, including the 5 mol% footnote and Cu(NO3)2·3H2O substitution.
Chromatographic conversion of 2a to 3a (87%) is the workup stage of the same standard 1a experiment, not a separate independent run.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Scheme 4 products 3a–3n and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: All printed scope arrows were inventoried. Separate 1 mmol and 5 mmol lines were retained as separate experiments; recoveries for 3c, 3m, and 3n remain recovery outcomes rather than product yields.

unresolved: Most scope operational details are supplied only in later experimental paragraphs and were linked cross-page.
The 3n shared 10 mol% statement conflicts with page-6 0.05 mmol quantities.
No SI file is explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 5 and adjacent discussion
regions.finding: Distinct 1o-to-2o experiment retained: oxidation at room temperature under O2 for 8 h and silica chromatography gives homopropargylic ketone 2o in 65%; no isomerized product was observed.

regions.region: page 3 Experimental section 4.1 and 4.2.1 typical procedure
regions.finding: The exact 1a/Fe(NO3)3·9H2O/TEMPO/NaCl/DCE/O2 procedure, mesitylene crude-NMR operation, TLC, chromatography, 124.7 mg, and 87% isolated 3a were merged with Scheme 2/Table 1 entry 1/Scheme 3.
Two separate 3b runs (1 mmol, 5 h, 91%; 5 mmol, 4 h, 86%) and one 3c run (1 mmol, 24 h, 54%; 31% starting material recovered by NMR) were retained with exact quantities and masses.

unresolved: The starting materials 1a–1o are stated to follow reference 9; their syntheses are not experiments reported in the supplied pages.
Structures remain machine candidates despite visual inspection and parse checks; no SI association is established.

regions.region: page 4 sections 4.2.4–4.2.7, all reaction arrows and experimental paragraphs
regions.finding: Eight independent experiments were retained: 1 mmol and 5 mmol preparations for each 3d, 3e, 3f, and 3g, including row-specific times, quantities, isolated masses/yields, and chromatography eluents.

unresolved: Spectral characterization supports source identity but does not make machine structures verified.
No associated SI file was used.

regions.region: page 5 sections 4.2.8–4.2.11, all reaction arrows and experimental paragraphs
regions.finding: Eight independent experiments were retained: 1 mmol and 5 mmol preparations for each 3h, 3i, 3j, and 3k, with exact quantities, times, isolated masses, and yields. The 5 mmol 3j paragraph does not restate an eluent, which remains explicit as missing rather than copied from a neighboring row.

unresolved: The chromatography eluent for the 5 mmol 3j run is not stated in its detailed paragraph.
Candidate structures remain unverified; no SI association is established.

regions.finding: Five scope conditions were retained: 3l at 1 mmol and 5 mmol, 3m at 1 mmol with 40% recovery, 3n at 1 mmol with 44% recovery, and 2o at 1 mmol with no allenic isomerization. Exact quantities, times, masses, and yields were structured.

A source conflict is preserved: Scheme 4/shared footnote says 10 mol% each catalyst, but the 3n experimental paragraph prints 0.05 mmol each on a 1.0 mmol substrate scale. No value was silently corrected.

Shangze Wu is thanked for reproducing results for compounds 3b and 3m. The 3b statement does not identify which scale was repeated, and no independent conditions/outcomes are supplied; supporting notes were attached without creating duplicate experiments.

regions.region: page 6 Supplementary data statement and start of References
regions.finding: The paper points to online supplementary data, but source_mapping.json marks the SI association unestablished. No SI facts or external-reference experiments were inferred or imported.

unresolved: The 3n 10 mol% versus 0.05 mmol catalyst discrepancy remains unresolved.
The acknowledgement does not identify the reproduced 3b scale or provide separate measurements.
SI association remains unestablished; references were not imported as current-paper experiments.
